title: Approve release 1 scope (PRD version 2)
decision: Release 1 consists of features FEAT-001 to FEAT-023 as specified in PRD version 2: staff roles, itemized credit entries with a goods catalog, promised repayment dates, customer notification with dispute and no confirmation, Mini App and web panel, Uzbek and Russian, reminders with SMS fallback behind a switch, credit limits and in-shop payment history, owner reports, 30-day trial and a subscription of 100,000 UZS a month paid by card transfer with administrator approval, platform administration, and production-grade non-functional targets
context: The founder changed direction in DEC-012 and defined the release through the question form on 2026-10-06; stages 05 to 10 must be revised to match
rationale: Specifies what the founder decided. Most new scope rests on a single assumption-type record (EVID-034); legality of collecting payments without a registered entity and Telegram's payment rules (EVID-028) are unresolved; price is about four times the incumbent entry tier (EVID-021).
